title: Lenin on India
author: Buddhadeb Bhattacharjee
description: An exhaustive historical survey of V.I. Lenin's writings, speeches, and internationalist perspectives on colonial India, the 1908 Bombay general strike, and the Indian national liberation movement.

title: October Revolution: Imprint on Freedom Struggles - I
bengaliTitle: অক্টোবর বিপ্লব: ভারতের স্বাধীনতা সংগ্রামে তার অনপনেয় স্বাক্ষর ১
author: Sitaram Yechury
description: A profound exploration of how the 1917 Great October Socialist Revolution transformed global anti-colonial movements, inspiring the working class and peasant uprisings throughout the colonized world.

title: October Revolution: Imprint on Freedom Struggles - II
bengaliTitle: অক্টোবর বিপ্লব: ভারতের স্বাধীনতা সংগ্রামে তার অনপনেয় স্বাক্ষর ২
author: Sitaram Yechury
description: Analyzing the profound resonance of the Russian Revolution in the minds and writings of Rabindranath Tagore, Mahatma Gandhi, Bhagat Singh, and Jawaharlal Nehru.

title: October Revolution: Imprint on Freedom Struggles - III
bengaliTitle: অক্টোবর বিপ্লব: ভারতের স্বাধীনতা সংগ্রামে তার অনপনেয় স্বাক্ষর ৩
author: Sitaram Yechury
description: The founding of the Communist Party of India in Tashkent, the radical evolution of the Ghadar movement, Bhagat Singh's Kirti journal, and the rise of organized trade union and peasant struggles.

title: Lenin and Anti-Colonial Struggle
author: Ratan Khasnabis
description: An incisive theoretical critique of Lenin's thesis on imperialism as the highest stage of capitalism and its enduring validity in contemporary global anti-colonial discourse.

title: Vidyasagar's Dialectic: Scripture vs History
author: Ramkrishna Bhattacharya
description: A pioneering examination of Ishwar Chandra Vidyasagar's debate tactics—how humanistic and historical materialism operated beneath the tactical framework of traditional Sanskrit scriptures.

title: Health in Marx's Thought: Labor, Capital & Emancipation
bengaliTitle: মার্কসের চিন্তায় স্বাস্থ্য: স্বাস্থ্য, শ্রম ও মানবমুক্তি
author: Kumar Rana
description: Interrogating the commodification of bodily well-being under capitalist accumulation and tracing Karl Marx's vital insights on occupational health, alienation, and human flourishing.

title: Reclaiming Smith, Rereading Marx
author: Abhijit Ghosh
description: Rescuing Adam Smith's moral philosophy and labor theory of value from neoliberal distortion, and engaging in a rigorous modern re-reading alongside Karl Marx's critique of political economy.
